Codes:
x: Indian Polity: Organs of the State PMF IAS IP – 48 Both statements are correct: Article 59 states that the President shall not be a member of either House of Parliament or of a State Legislature; if a sitting member is elected President, their seat is deemed vacant upon assuming office. Article 79 provides that Parliament consists of the President and the two Houses — the Council of States (Rajya Sabha) and the House of the People (Lok Sabha). s: What s the position of representation of Anglo-Indian Community in Lok Sabha ?
o: Nomination of them has been done away with by 104th
Two anglo-Indians are nominated by the President

x: The provision for the representation of the Anglo-Indian community in the Lok Sabha was made under Article 331 of the Constitution. According to this Article, even though provisions were made in Article 81, if the President was of the opinion that the Anglo-Indian community was not adequately represented in the Lok Sabha, he could nominate two members of that community to the Lok Sabha. According to Article 334, this provision was made initially for a period of 10 years in the Constitution. Later, it was extended for periods of 10 years each. Through the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019, Article 334 was amended to extend the provision of reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies for another 10 years (80 years from the commencement of the Constitution). However, the provision for the representation of Anglo-Indians was not extended further and was terminated.

s: The maximum number of members in Lok Sabha can be -
x: According to Article 81 of the Indian Constitution, the maximum number of members in Lok Sabha can be 550 (530 from states and 20 from Union territories). According to Article 331, notwithstanding anything in Article 81, the President, if he is of the opinion that the Anglo-Indian community is not adequately represented in the Lok Sabha, could nominate not more than two members of that community to the Lok Sabha. It is noteworthy that the arrangements of nominating 2 representatives of the Anglo-Indian community in the Lok Sabha have not been extended beyond the stipulated date (25 January, 2020) by" The Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019". There are currently 543 members in Lok Sabha. (524 members from the states + 19 members from the Union Territories).

s: How many seats are reserved for UTs in Lok Sabha?
x: According to Article 81 (As Amended by the 31st Amendment Act, 1973 and Goa, Daman and Diu Reorganisation Act, 1987) of the Constitution, for the Lok Sabha a maximum of 530 members can be elected from the states and 20 from the constituencies of Union Territories. Currently, the number of Lok Sabha seats in the Union Territories is 19 (Delhi-7, Andaman and Nicobar-1, Chandigarh-1, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu-2, Lakshadweep-1, Puducherry-1, Jammu & Kashmir-5, Ladakh-1) while in Rajya Sabha it is 8 (Delhi-3, Puducherry-1, Jammu and Kashmir-4).

s: The Strength of the Lok Sabha was increased from 525 to 545 through which Amendment?
x: 31st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1973, increased the strength of the Lok Sabha from 525 to 545. The Number of members representing States was increased from 500 to 525 and the number of members representing Union Territories was decreased from 25 to 20.

At Present, the members of Lok Sabha are 550 (530 members From the states + 20 members from the Union Territories). It is noteworthy that the arrangements of nominating 2 representatives of the Anglo-Indian Community in the Lok Sabha have not been extended beyond the stipulated date (25 January, 2020) by 'The Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019.

s: Maximum strength of Lok Sabha as stipulated in the Constitution of India is -
x: Lok Sabha is the House of the People. Its members are elected through direct election. The maximum number of its members could be 552 (530 from states + 20 from UTs + 2 from Anglo- Indian Community) [Article 81, 331]. Thus its maximum strength can be 550.
